notes.title: Multiplayer | Devlog #4
notes.content:
🔔WISHLIST ESCAPE ACADEMY 2🔔[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]Hey there Escapists!

Last week we had a blog on multiplayer systems - the super cool stuff that’ll help you get along with your teammate a little better - outlines, pings, and emotes! However, we wanted to dedicate a blog to go over the concept of multiplayer as a whole, how it’s shaping up for Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School, and some of what you can expect.
Not enough time to read?[p align="start"]That’s okay. Luckily for you, we’ve got that handled. Check out our YouTube devlog on multiplayer!
[p align="start"]
[previewyoutube="vcKvOSfG8Ww;full"][/previewyoutube]Why Good Multiplayer is Important[p align="start"]Escape Academy 1’s multiplayer was exactly what you’d expect out of a co-op escape room experience: you could give your partner items, and they existed in the same space as you while you solved puzzles. This did its job well, as you wouldn’t be exploring larger areas, but during some playtests for Escape Academy 2, we realized that multiplayer needed some upgrades.
[p align="start"] 
Our Process[p align="start"]Escape Academy 1 taught us that playtesting is incredibly important. Just look at these internal documents I “borrowed” from our [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/6609cfbd85bb33d94f7fa05b1ce45de7cb5ac6cd.png"]retrospective last year!


[p align="start"]While we were playtesting, we found a couple of issues with multiplayer that made it a little difficult for players to get the full experience out of an open-world game. But, we were missing something.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/9482a433b523336a0bee0775d719d6d330c4c271.png"]

When it comes to Escape Academy 2, our pool of playtesters is much larger and we’re making sure to use this to our advantage. With the first game, we let it fall behind for the reasons listed above, and this led to some of our puzzles in the later portions of the game losing the consistency we built with the early portions of the game. You might not have even noticed this as a player, but to us as a studio, it was leagues of difference.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/bcdb6be3cd22ab3f87e4236d982ad1eac151187f.png"]



Consistent playtesting has led us to be a lot happier, and much more confident, when it comes to our puzzle/world design with Escape Academy 2. Now, whenever we’re making something, we try not to call it fun until we’ve seen another player have fun with it. And even then, we want to playtest it over and over again to make sure that what we’re seeing is genuine enjoyment out of puzzle lovers like us.
[p align="start"]Playtesting has been a huge help for building out our open-world multiplayer.


Open-World Multiplayer[p align="start"]A large campus brings large demands. Meet Player 1 and Player 2 - two of our playtesters here to help demonstrate how we came to the addition of the new multiplayer systems we introduced in our last blog.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/f6887c1eadbadfd177a2c6b27d2dbbb99f01b58f.png"]

Nice to meet you, Player 1 and Player 2! Let’s take a look at how your playtests went.


Challenge 1:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/27b03cd1bb0e984d9f650047d644c847c11cd7e5.png"]

Player 1 is not the best when it comes to descriptive language - but Player 2 has the projector still that leads to one of the 3 answers needed for this puzzle. So, Player 1 says:

”I think you can put that projector still in that projector over there”

But Player 2 is beyond lost. “Over where? I don’t see it!” Well, it’s certainly not on the ceiling.
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]Thanks to Player 2, Escape Academy now has pings for the first time ever.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/146b563d6670a74617676ebd8e7447eedd7110c4.png"]


Challenge 2:[p align="start"]Both players just finished an escape room. Great! But now they’re just standing there. Menacingly. Soullessly.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/18d1ca2755b9f761b992dc43062c15a40c05a229.png"]



However, our brand-new WIP emotes system is bound to fix that and give Player 1 and Player 2 an outlet to let out some of that extra energy. Let’s celebrate!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/1600e50c74e5a8ebf945326d8e9fa4190749aa9c.png"]


Challenge 3:[p align="start"]Lastly, it’s easy to get lost in an open world campus. You might be able to meet up in a designated spot on campus, or just learn the map, but to us, being able to keep a close eye on your partner makes staying together a little bit easier.
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]Now, no matter where you are, you can keep a close eye on your partner. Whether they know it or not.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/b67c6cc8e543250bc31c2bb00b9f6a4f177973e0.png"]




My Fun Is Not Your Fun[p align="start"]Lastly, one of the biggest lessons we learned while making multiplayer, and subsequently playtesting the multiplayer experience, is that fun is subjective. I won’t go too deep into this here because it’s quite the lengthy topic and this blog is already quite tall, but if you want to see a talk on this, Gabe Newell has an excellent interview with a behavioural psychologist where he talks all about it.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Regardless, playtesting has taught us a lot about what “fun” is, and as compared to Escape Academy 1, we’ve made a vow to ourselves to not call something fun until we’ve seen someone else have fun with it first.
[p align="start"] 
See you next time![p align="start"]Hopefully you’re excited for multiplayer too - but what you see here isn’t the end of the road for us. We want your suggestions! If you have anything on your “Escape Academy 2’s Multiplayer Wishlist”, please let us know in the comments and we’ll take a deeper look at it!
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]If you’re excited about multiplayer too, make sure to let us know by putting us on your wishlist. And if you made it here, thank you for reading.

With love,
[p align="start"]Coin Crew Games💛💜


 🔔WISHLIST ESCAPE ACADEMY 2🔔

notes.title: Multiplayer Systems | Devlog #3
notes.content:
🔔WISHLIST ESCAPE ACADEMY 2: BACK 2 SCHOOL!🔔[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]Hey Escapists!
[p align="start"]We hope you enjoyed our first longform devlog on YouTube; expect another one soon! 👀


[p align="start"]One of our favourite staples of Escape Academy 1 was the multiplayer interactions that led to silly moments, or gave way to fun conversations with players. Bringing people together is fun! I mean, it’s even in our motto.
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]So far, we’ve had a few questions on the topic of multiplayer interactions:

Will there be online multiplayer?

Splitscreen couch co-op? 🥺

Toggleable splitscreen?
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]To put the answers shortly:
YES! and…[p align="start"]There’s also a couple of things we’re adding to change up the way duos will explore the Academy - both to help with interacting in an open world, and to make the multiplayer experience that much more interesting.
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]Let’s take a look 🧐
What’s Different?[p align="start"]It’s a bird! It’s a plane! It’s a….ping?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/10bbfe2124dadbfc402bcc6b601ae11263729f62.png"]

When it comes to an escape room, things are a lot more localized. You can say “Hey, come check this out!” and walk a few feet over to your partner. Maybe your duo will point out something “over there, by that desk.” But when you’re exploring a giant sprawling campus, “over there” becomes a bit….confusing. Pings have quickly become a staple in many multiplayer experiences, and we think that bringing them into the world of Escape Academy will help make solving puzzles together less frustrating, while also leading to some silly interactions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/2277986f943d23d8e3bc2feafe1aded0f510a72d.png"]
What if I get lost?[p align="start"]That’s a fair argument. If you’ve been keeping up with our devlogs and short-form content, it’s a very real concern. Escape Academy is the leading academy in the art of Escape, after all!
[p align="start"] 
[p align="start"]While many multiplayer games might opt to leash you within a certain range of the first player, we don’t want players to be limited to any single area - that can take away from the open world experience. So instead, cutting-edge Academy technology will allow you to see where your partner is on campus at any given point!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/f71fe89423515b2fbf8edb773b96809801473d7c.png"]

Still struggling to find eachother? That’s okay. The gazebo in the middle of campus is an excellent place to relax and meet up before planning your next escape.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/90ceb385a4b7115ce3b6e13a8bf22dd1c9de2d48.png"]
Emotes🥳💃
Every good Escapist needs a way to express themselves. We’re bringing emotes to Escape Academy as a way to help players communicate, for the better or for the worse. Solved that difficult puzzle? That deserves a thumbs up! Struggling with a spinner lock? Seems like the perfect opportunity for a sarcastic clap.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/ed3695796825988e3676e595c7bfce20974f8a66.png"]
What else?[p align="start"]One of the complaints from playtesters we’ve gotten is that splitscreen modes in online gameplay can be a little disorienting. So, just like in Escape Academy 1, you’ll have the option to switch between the splitscreen and widescreen views if motion sickness is something that affects you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/e6611761ece3f3be32b5c5e42ebbae53e6ab780b.png"]



Partner taking a little too long to unpause in couch co-op? Time to take things into your own hands.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/7546d425b6969614d093ba02846d9fb09957fe29.png"]

Lastly, to keep things from being a little too janky (or asking for a little too much out of your computer), players will have to enter escape rooms together. Always remember that two minds are better than one! Usually.


See you in the next one!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/94d7eaff66b82734043c6f5dd335d683e9eedde6.png"]

We’re hoping multiplayer features will give just the right amount of sass to multiplayer interactions, and help to immerse you in the world of Escape Academy a little bit. If you have anything on your wishlist for Escape Academy 2 features, just let us know in the comments!



That’s all from us - for now. Stay tuned for another longform devlog coming soon, and don’t forget to…
🔔WISHLIST ESCAPE ACADEMY 2: BACK 2 SCHOOL!🔔


With Love,
[p align="start"]Coin Crew Games💛💜

notes.title: A (Sneak) Peek Behind The Curtain, and Some Transparency….
notes.content:
Hey Escapists! 
We know you’re just as excited as we are to get your hands on the next playtest build of Escape Acadmey 2: Back 2 School, so we’re bringing you an update with some of your most-asked questions, and a few peeks at what’s been going on at the Academy!

 
I joined the Discord! When can I playtest?!
We’re SO excited to start playtests (and on a personal note, community manager to community - I am very excited to watch you all playtest the next build!) That’s why with much excitement, I’m here to tell you:


Weekly Playtests are Kicking Off July 17th!
 

Keep your eyes peeled in our Discord, where you’ll be able to claim a spot for playtesting, and over there we’ll have more information on what you can expect out of the playtesting process.

 

While you can’t playtest right now, there are a few other things you can do to satisfy your curiosity:
[olist]
Check out our socials! We’re constantly looking for new content to post, and with playtests starting back up, you’ll be able to expect some sneak peeks, funny bugs, and more!

Join the Discord. There’s plenty of fun to be had, and you can say hi to your beloved Coin Crew devs directly👋

Check out our other posts! We’re always looking for stuff to post, but if there’s something you’re wanting to see, it’s possible we’ve already posted it. And if we haven’t….

Ask questions! We’re just as excited to make this game as you are to play it, and hype keeps everyone motivated.
[/olist]Those Sneak Peeks We Were Promised!?
Our art team has been cooking up some really sick concepts for some other campuses at The Academy - after all, it’s more than just a school. It’s a thriving campus!

 

Here’s some work-in-progress concept art for the upcoming Science Campus you’ll be able to attend at Escape Academy. 📚What you see first are the grayboxed versions, followed by some paintover 🎨 sketches showing off how we plan to truly give these grayboxed environments life!😍

 

We hope you enjoy this early look into the design process as much as we enjoy making it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649515/020f43f26cc1425d05c97cb210ed7b4a1b5c9eef.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649515/185a355c658da77c4cf9c42dbb4960ba81a3515c.png"]

                             ⚠️WIP! Expect this area to evolve and change in future iterations💛💜


We want to know your questions!
What do YOU want out of Escape Academy 2? What are your wildest puzzle fantasies, or your weirdest escape-themed dreams? Is having the ability to pick up the Purfessor a requirement for your enjoyment? Or maybe you REALLY want Gillian to be a bit more yappy?🤔



Whatever your asks are, we want our game to be a love letter to escape room games, fun puzzles, and purpose-built for our community to bash their heads into. Let us know what you’d like to see, and we’ll let you know what we think! The best way to reach us is always through Discord, but feel free to drop your thoughts anywhere you see us lurking around on the internet…⬇️


🔔Wishlist Escape Academy 2!🔔 


With love,

Coin Crew Games 💛💜

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase Bundles, Discounts and More!
notes.content:
What starts with “Cerebral” and rhymes with “Shmuzzle Shmowbase”?

That’s right. Escape Academy is officially part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, a week-long extravaganza guaranteed to tickle your brain with some of the best puzzle-forward games Steam has to offer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/9b531f13684f4c37539a7e86ce37189d44536dc4.png

We’re beyond excited to be featured in a celebration of the smartest, trickiest, and most satisfying puzzle games available. Whether you’re decoding cryptic messages or racing the clock with your duo, now is the time to sharpen your wits and dive in.

Did someone say SALES and BUNDLES?

I don’t think so, but now that we’re here…

To celebrate our involvement in Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, we’re rolling out not just one, but THREE of our favorite Escape Academy deals yet. It's a bundle of bundles!

Escape Room Bundle

We’ve partnered with the teams that made Botany Manor, Escape From Mystwood Mansion, and We Were Here Together to bring you the Escape Room Bundle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/80f01290736b686b003614235f43bd3d3d4ab45d.png

If you’re into escape rooms and good times, this bundle is for you!

It’ll only be available as long as the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase is around (until June 5th!), so grab it before it’s gone here 👉Escape Room Bundle

Slime Rancher 2 Bundle

Looking for the perfect mix of clever puzzles and cozy vibes? Look no further. Our friends working on Slime Rancher 2 have worked with us to bring you the gooey charm of Slime Rancher 2 with the brain-bending challenges of Escape Academy; all in one beautiful package.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/98845bfda80718420517f8496dda4c08e6c86a4b.png

Regardless of if you’re into herding slimes or racing the clock to escape a deadly classroom, the Escape Academy & Slime Rancher 2 Bundle is your one-way ticket to good times.

Grab it here! 👉Slime Rancher 2 Bundle

———————————————————————————————————————————————————

Lastly, we will be ON SALE (60% off!) until June 12th to celebrate our participation in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase. If you’ve been waiting for an excuse to get Escape Academy for you and/or that one close friend who’s just staring at you with puppy eyes (🥺👉👈) waiting for the opportunity to play a critically acclaimed puzzle game with you, now’s the time.  

Goodbye….for now….

That’s all from us today - but expect more activity in the coming weeks. (months? years? :eyes: ) 

👇 Check out our Linktree, where you’ll be able to join our community on Discord and say hi to the team! Link Tree

We’re cooking up something that we think you’ll love.

notes.title: Tournament of Puzzles Patch 3.0.6 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello Escapists! 

While everyone has been puzzling their pants off in the Tournament of Puzzles, the dev team has been gathering responses and working on a patch to address some player feedback so it is our pleasure to announce that Escape Academy v3.0.6.1 is now live across all platforms!

What's in the Patch?

I'm so glad you asked!

[olist]
 Fixed Power Hungry Achievement bug where the counter was only going up in online play, works both in online and split screen now.
 Made the laser splitter component on the Showman's Studio Laser Grid puzzle stationary for balance purposes.
 Fixed bug where on rare occasions, the box of swords puzzle wouldn't open with a correct solution.
 Fixed bug where if two puzzles of the same type spawned in the same chamber, upon completion of the first puzzle, the necessary item for the second puzzle would be removed from inventory.
 Fixed rare save file corruption issue.
 Applied collider and item spawn point polish.
[/olist]

Thank You for Playing!

As always, a HUGE thank you to everyone who's been playing Tournament of Puzzles! 

It's been a joy to see everyone work through the new achievements and interact with one another on discord for a little healthy competition amongst Puzzletes. 

We are so grateful to our community and are overjoyed by the responses and thoughtful feedback everyone has provided for all of Escape Academy's releases.

You...

Complete...

Sequences of complicated, brain busting puzzles at a rate that frequently scares the dev team!

And us. You complete us. 

We love you all.

GLHF,

Coin Crew Games

notes.title: Tournament of Puzzles is Available Now!

Hey there Escapist!

[previewyoutube=BYJOXGr0qdM;full][/previewyoutube]

Did Somebody Say Sale?

Somebody DID-- and on MULTIPLE OCCASIONS! 

For the next week Escape Academy is 50% off and if you're hungry for even MORE Escape Academy, the Season Pass is on sale for 20% off!

Hit the road with Coach Yoach and experience all new arenas, game modes, power-ups, and PUZZLES! Solve your way through giant, replayable arenas filled with secret passages, alternate routes and randomized puzzles.

notes.title: Tournament of Puzzles Release Update - Targeting Late Q1 2024
notes.content:
Hey there Escapists!

As the year comes to a close, we wanted to spend just a moment to thank you for making 2023 such an awesome year for Escape Academy.

It saw the release of our second DLC, Escape Academy: Escape from the Past, and a plethora of playtests for our upcoming, free update Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles. Speaking of-- we have an update on the update for all of you!

Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles is targeting a late Q1 2024 release!

While we would have loved to share the update with you before the end of the year, our team decided that it needed more development and polish time to make it the most crazy, competitive, and clean experience possible!

Keep your eyes peeled in the new year for more information about the specific release timing.

What's in the Tournament of Puzzles Free Update?

Three New Competitive Game Modes
Escapists can go head to head in Escape Race, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Scavenger Hunt which all feature unique new mechanics!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/d964ff01d97b0cf8d4a64846bb5fd00232d5120c.png
Escape Race - First one to grab the trophy at the end of the track wins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/f38d7ff6d993e396798b10e7cb57bc05ce22fb35.png
Tic-Tac-Toe - Solve puzzles to unlock X’s and O’s. Outsmart your opponent to get three-in-a-row!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/3792d798f404f873fa3f6546db7fdf6d86baa8ac.png
Scavenger Hunt - Use your keen eye to find trophies hiding in plain sight. Collect more than your opponent to claim victory!

Massive New Arenas
These new arenas are the biggest environments to date with their own set of unique puzzles and numerous distinct paths through each series of chambers.

notes.title: Tournament of Puzzles Steam Public Playtest Live Now!
notes.content:
Hello Escapists,

We're back with another Steam Public Playtest of our free update, Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles! Take a look to see how you can get involved. 

What’s in store at the Tournament of Puzzles?

Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles, takes the Academy’s students on the road with Coach Yoach to showdown at various arenas across the globe and compete for glory in multiple Escape events.

The playtest this weekend will take place at the Egyptian themed arena, The Tomb of the First Escapist, and feature three PvP modes, two of which are brand new to the Tournament of Puzzles!

Escape Race: First player to solve all the puzzles, unlock all the doors, and grab the trophy wins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/b34965a6aa17e15eb395f6dac7282d41a0cee9a9.png

Tic-Tac-Toe: Solve puzzles in order to unlock your team color gems, then place them on a 3x3 tic-tac-toe grid. First to connect three wins the match!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/91e7c452fa98855114459968ab9dddf6c82442a3.png

Scavenger Hunt: Throughout the level, trophies have been hidden in plain sight. First player to collect the majority of the trophies will claim victory!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/ebe4e8d71453df00c0aa4f1bde196ad1fd0b1675.png

And if you wanna take the update for a whirl but don’t have a buddy (or just want to play in sweet, sweet solitude) then check out the practice-race mode available for solo play! 

For more information on the power-ups and to-be-released arenas, strike up a conversation with Coach Yoach in the lobby. He’ll give you the lowdown on everything you can expect to find in the full update!

How do I access the Tournament of Puzzles?

Installing the playtest build is as simple as stopping by our store page and pressing the green “request access” button under the playtest header. It will install a separate build of the game that just includes the update and will playable for a limited time only. Launch this from your Steam library and you’re on your way to puzzling!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/450aed74e5ab3a1115b37c65de31e2ea6bdff035.png

Once in the build, play through the very first level (if you haven’t already) in order to gain access to the main campus map screen. Once here, press tab to bring up the “Level Packs” screen and select the Tournament of Puzzles. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/a0f2d09dea6ec3b65543b555e973a061d6a6475b.png

Now you will be in the Tournament of Puzzles lobby where clicking the trophy cabinet will allow you to choose your game mode and arena track. Each mode offers a new way to engage with the puzzles and your opponent while track selection will effect your route through the massive arenas.

NOTE: For now, the only arena available will be The Tomb of the First Escapist. The full update will contain two other full levels, The Hackannery, and The Showman’s Studio. This playtest does however feature all the modes that will be available in the full update, so give them all a try!

What if I’m a super cool fan who wants to give you guys feedback on my experience?

Wow! You are a super cool fan. We would be honored to hear your feedback and have you partake in making this update as good as it can be! For those ace Escapists who would like to go that extra mile, please fill out this brief Google survey so the dev team can continue to improve the experience. 

If you encounter any bugs, please feel free to drop by our Discord and visit the #🐛-buglogs channel so we can track the issues on our end and get to work on a fix.

Thanks for Playtesting

And don’t forget to have fun out there on the Puzzle Pitch with your fellow Escapists! We’re pumped about bringing you guys in to our development process and can’t wait to hear what you have to say. 

As always--

GLHF,

Coin Crew Games

notes.title: Happy One Year Anniversary to Escape Academy!
notes.content:
Hello Escapists! 

We can hardly believe it, but Escape Academy has been out in the world for an entire year! It’s been such a warm welcome to the digital games space and we’re floored by the support the game (and its DLCs!) have gotten from the community. From the bottom of everyone’s heart here at Coin Crew Games, THANK YOU! This is a milestone worthy of celebration-- and there’s a few ways we’re going to do that. 

Behold-- Glorious Gameplay Stats!

With a whole year of escapin' under everyone’s belts, we wanted to pull some fun stats about Escape Academy’s student body! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/31f10f077eec9987c2557603b107bb1cd27b8135.png

Over 1.61 million players, 145 million puzzles solved, 10 million rooms escaped, and a student body GPA average of B+ is absolutely brilliant! We couldn’t ask for a brighter and more dedicated class of Escapists.

Cerebral Puzzle Showcase Feature, Sale, and Stream

That’s right, as part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, Escape Academy is on sale for 30% and for the very first time, the season pass will be discounted at 15% off! That’s a whole lot of Escape (23 levels to be exact) available at a discounted price!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/ec19c03c4e4f9f3f0b68c8bbc26046e9448a2b60.png

In addition to the sale, we’ll be running a stream all weekend where Coin Crew Games devs, Wyatt Bushnell (Studio Co-Founder) attempts to play through the game blind folded while Blair Lachlan Scott (Writer & Producer), does his best to coach him through the levels by giving him instructions while observing his screen. 

We can’t guarantee how effective of a play style this is going to wind up being, but we can certainly promise some unhinged commentary and loads of laughs. Drop on the by the store page this weekend to take a look!

Tournament of Puzzles Public Playtest

Escape Academy’s free update, the Tournament of Puzzles, is back with another public playtest! We spent a long time digesting everyone’s feedback and are back with a revamped version of the update that places an emphasis on PvP puzzling, power-ups, and additional game modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/6c117270da2525187efd5732d2a0a0f92943cf2c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/91e7c452fa98855114459968ab9dddf6c82442a3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/ebe4e8d71453df00c0aa4f1bde196ad1fd0b1675.png

The playtest will be taking place this weekend starting tomorrow, Friday 8/3, and will wrap up Monday 8/7 in the morning (Pacific). Please keep your eyes peeled for our follow up post which will inform all of you that the playtest is live, what to expect, and how you can help us make the update even better!

Thank You!

Once again, we’d like to thank everyone for the continued interest and passion for Escape Academy. We can’t wait to share our update with you and look forward to seeing everyone out on the Puzzle Pitch for the Steam Public Playtest. 

And remember--

GLHF,

Coin Crew Games

notes.title: Escape Academy - Release Schedule Update
notes.content:
Hello Escapists!

Coin Crew Games has been hard at work testing The Tournament of Puzzles update and putting the finishing touches on  our second DLC, Escape Academy: Escape from the Past. We wanted to take a moment to share some updates with everyone!

Updated Release Timing for The Tournament of Puzzles

First off we wanted to thank everyone who partook in our Steam Playtest of The Tournament of Puzzles earlier this year. The feedback was immensely insightful and we were thrilled with the results and everyone’s thoughts. After ingesting feedback from the Steam Playtest, we made the decision to re-center the experience on PvP play. The dev team is in the process of building out new mechanics that lean into player on player interactions and maximize the frantic nature of trying to solve puzzles faster than your opponent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/5d105f28d094ae8934552c6a8ca549bbbd2b0492.png

As a result, The Tournament of Puzzles is going to be coming out later than we’d originally hoped. We are now targeting a Q4 2023 release across all platforms. But there IS good news as well, which is that we’re going to be running more tests in order to build an experience that we’re all happy with! We want your involvement to yield an update we’re all proud of and one that you’ll have a hard time putting down. Keep your eyes peeled for more Steam Playtests and take a look at this Digital Trends article to gain some more insight into our new design direction.

Learnings from the Escape from Anti-Escape Island Release

We’d also like to take a moment to share our biggest learning  from releasing our first DLC last fall: Escape from Anti-Escape Island released in a buggier state than we were happy with, and you all rightfully gave us that feedback. For Escape from the Past, we’ve spent extra polish and QA time to make for as smooth and frustration free of an experience as possible. This is also a part of the reason we’ve decided to give The Tournament of Puzzles more time in the oven. Not only do we want the design to wow everyone and fuel all sorts of puzzle rivalries, we want it to be a smooth, bug free experience.

Speaking of our upcoming DLC…

Introducing Escape Academy: Escape from the Past!

For those of you who caught the Nintendo Indie World stream this morning and watched our full Nintendo Switch, Complete Edition, Trailer you may have noticed some brand new footage from our upcoming DLC, Escape Academy: Escape from the Past. This DLC is included in the Season Pass and will be released late Spring 2023!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/1c3dde07eab3d55cf6a3c8028e081a0127e03350.png

Escape from the Past, is a prequel that puts players in control of familiar faces Sandra Solange and Eel Barnes as they begin their journey from Academy students to the unstoppable team of master Escapists we meet in Escape Academy.

After an “accident” at an Academy sporting event, Headmaster Horatio Windsor believes that SOMEONE at the school wants him dead. He enlists Sandra and Eel to go undercover in order to investigate each of the suspected faculty members. As the "accidents" keep piling up, players must successfully navigate (and survive!) five, all new rooms while piecing together clues spread across each in order to deduce who the killer is. It's an Escape Academy whodunnit!

Thank You

As always, thanks is owed to you, our awesome fanbase who give us awesome feedback (and have patience while we act on it). Coin Crew Games is working tirelessly to bring you exciting content with the quality as you deserve.

Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming content and playtests!

Cheers,
-Coin Crew Games

notes.title: Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles Steam Playtest is live NOW!
notes.content:
Hello and Happy New Year fellow Escapists! 

Coin Crew Games has exciting news about our free major update: it’s titled Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles, it features procedurally generated escape rooms, and the best part? You can playtest it NOW using the Steam Playtest feature!

What is Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles?

Escape Academy: Tournament of Puzzles is our free, major content update which introduces one of the community's most requested features: replayable levels! 

Join Coach Yoach and his crack team of Puzzletes as they compete against other Escape schools  to bring the championship cup back home to Escape Academy!

Tournament of Puzzles features procedurally generated escape rooms that take place in all new, massive arenas themed around each Escape school. Puzzle your way through the rainy, neon labyrinth at Hackademy’s “Phish Market” and do your best to survive the perils of History High’s “The Tomb of the First Escapist.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/ab1b3f0c5bc4d8ba8fe3a07ae94299ef03558d54.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/0d2f904820019aba2af834ee80bdc29fc60dba02.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/c69ba04272765124ab183ae65e31dc25a40d66db.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/d5931c6695186c9a15e54de0c7f74d593d97d084.png

Every time you compete in a heat of the tournament, you’ll encounter different puzzles and challenges, procedurally selected from our ever-growing depot of brain twisters. No two runs will be the same!

The Tournament of Puzzles Playtest can be played single player or in co-op!

A NOTE ABOUT MULTIPLAYER: While online play is accessible in this build, there are known desync issues that will make the completion of levels nearly impossible. We strongly urge players to stick to playing locally with friends for the best co-op experience. Steam remote play or other third party screensharing apps could function as an alternative. Enter online at your own risk!

How does the playtest work?

Pay a visit to our Store Page and request access to the Steam Playtest! This playtest will run from today, Friday 1/27 to Monday 1/30 and everyone who requests access will be permitted to play.

On Monday morning, we’ll close access in order to take some time digesting your feedback, incorporate it back into the game, and get ready for another playtest! 

You don’t even need to own the base game in order to access the playtest so if you don’t own the game, you can hop on in without spending a dime!


What is the purpose of this playtest?

The purpose of this playtest is to gather feedback in order to improve and build out this new mode of play. As lots of its elements are experimental in nature, we wanted to hear what you’d like to see in a procedural escape room experience. Our hope is that by opening this up publicly, we can gather large amounts of player feedback and refine the update before its full release across all platforms.

We want to emphasize that this content is still in active development, and therefore players may experience issues that haven't been ironed out yet. So, while not the primary purpose of this playtest, we will also be making note of any major bugs discovered by players (and we appreciate the flagging of those when they occur).

Rigorous playtesting has always been a part of building Escape Academy, and Steam Playtests are a great chance to bring that to a significantly larger stage.


I’ve downloaded the build, how do I access Tournament of Puzzles?

Once in build, start a new save and quickly play through the tutorial level and make your way to the map screen. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/79da7d5232445fad574277e901904f1874194ee5.png

Once you arrive at the campus map, press TAB. Then, on the DLC select screen, select Tournament of Puzzles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/8116de96ef86c93af9dafc3afc5620d0b0714da4.png

After selecting Tournament of Puzzles you will be placed into a 3D diorama. On the left is a TV screen labeled “Tournament Mode” that you can click to start your first heat in the tournament!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120301/bb0af01d60ded3dcc188aa649e6c8474dae9e6e1.png

Where can we share our feedback?

General feedback can be submitted on our Steam page or on the #feedback channel of our Discord, but we’ve also built a questionnaire for more pointed questions and player input!

Questionnaire Link

Will there be more playtests?

Yes! Our goal is to run public playtests once a month until the full release of the Tournament of Puzzles across all platforms.

Thanks for helping us make our game better!

As mentioned, playtesting is a critical piece of development at Coin Crew Games and we’re thrilled to bring more of our playerbase into the development of our content. 

Keep your eyes peeled on our Twitter, Discord, and Steam Page for future playtests and other Escape Academy announcements!

Cheers, 
Coin Crew Games

notes.title: Escape Academy Patch 1.07 is Now Live!

Full patch notes are below-- but be warned! There are some puzzle spoilers below (for the last two levels). Read at your own risk!


High GPU consumption on Very High / Ultra graphics settings fixed.

notes.title: Escape from Anti-Escape Island - Upcoming Patch
notes.content:
Hey there Escapists!

We've made it through launch weekend on our first DLC and are glad people have been able to experience what the Coin Crew Games team has been hard at work building the last few months. That being said, we've received reports of bugs and some feedback on the UX for specific puzzles and we wanted to let everyone know that we're aware and actively working on fixes! 

We are super appreciative of the feedback and we wanted to make sure the community knows we're taking the reports seriously and we're shooting to get a fix out as quickly as possible (while ensuring all the fixes are bulletproof).

What are we working on?

There are a handful of nasty desync issues and one puzzle in particular has some UX smoothing out that's needed. More specific patch notes below.

POTENTIAL PUZZLE SPOILERS


Inappropriately large GPU consumption on Very High / Ultra graphics settings is getting smoothed out.
[spoiler]Chatterbox Achievement not firing properly on the base game after talking to the appropriate amount of characters is being fixed.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]On "The Experiment" there's multiple bugs with the spinning wheel, math puzzle on one of the turrets. These are being addressed.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]On "Into the Capture Dimension" there's issues where the laser-maze puzzle completes without placing the mirrors correctly and occasionally the mirrors get stacked on top of each other rendering the puzzle unsolvable. Both of these are being addressed.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Also on "Into the Capture Dimension," we've received a lot of feedback surrounding the UX on the mine field puzzle. In order to make this less frustrating, we are implementing a system that will reveal where previously triggered bombs are located on the board so it's not a COMPLETE reset every time a bomb is triggered.[/spoiler]


If there are additional bugs that have effected your experience with the DLC, please let us know in the comments or on our Discord! We want to make sure this patch captures and fixes as many issues as time allows.

Timeline

We are planning to push a new version of the game up to our "Hotfix" branch this Friday 11/18. 

As a heads up, it will take a bit longer to get the fixes pushed and ported to consoles, so for those cross-playing with friends on non-Steam platforms, there may be some compatibility issues on the hotfix branch as we're introducing new features for one of the puzzles.

Provided everything is stable, we'll get this all merged on to the main branch and all other platforms as soon as possible. 

A Note from Coin Crew Games

For those of you who've had their experience with the DLC and Escape Academy soured by bugs, we are sorry! We hope that these fixes will encourage those who were unable to finish the DLC, to do so. 

Your feedback and engagement is important to us so PLEASE continue to flag things as they arise. We'll do our best to fix in a timely manner and take all of these learnings into future Escape Academy content.

Cheers, 
Coin Crew Games

notes.title: Escape Academy Quality of Life Update - 8/16/2022
notes.content:
New Features:
Added the option to toggle split screen in online multiplayer.
Added a FoV slider under settings / graphics.
Added a hint confirmation - you now have to press the hint button twice.
Added best grade information to the replay board. Note: this is not backwards compatible, players will have to replay a level to see the best grade.

Bug fixes:
Fixed a bug where progress towards the Overachiever and Honor Roll achievements was not counted correctly.
Fixed a bug in Lab Rat that showed incorrect hint text for the last puzzle.
Fixed a bug in the Tea Kettle that made butterflies hard to see from certain angles.
Fixed a bug in Tea 'n' Tea that made bouquets hard to see from certain angles.
Fixed a bug in the dorm where the radio would highlight if the player hovered over the mirror.
Fixed a bug in Escape Artist that made the “side to side” statue puzzle occasionally fail to unlock correctly.
Fixed a bug in What Lies Below where some colorblind labels on the dance floor failed to display properly.
Added missing colorblind labels to the pachinko cabinet in the Rival Room.
Added missing colorblind labels to the balanced / imbalanced lights on the 3rd platform of the Rival Room.
Added missing colorblind labels to the server room switches in Lab Rat.
Other minor fixes.

Changes:
Increased maximum mouse sensitivity (25%).
Online partner’s mouse cursor is now hidden.
Changed the grading system to be a bit more harsh - we’re not grading on a curve anymore!
Changed key difficulties ratings for some rooms, to better match their actual difficulty.
